statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-4437 (GLIBC-SA-2026-0005, glibc bug 34014): in the GNU C Library 2.34 to 2.43, when nsswitch.conf uses the DNS backend, gethostbyaddr and gethostbyaddr_r ignored the answer-section boundary of a DNS response, so a crafted response from the configured DNS server could make the application treat records outside the answer section as valid answers. https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob_plain;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0005. Upstream fixed it on the 2.41 branch in https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=commit;h=dbd8335c8ce8af11226ee1514d7a020b15c63345 (resolv: Count records correctly). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.41-12+deb13u3 (Debian bug 1131435, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-4437). The one glibc build published in the DHI Debian repository is Debian's 2.41-12+deb13u4 rebuilt for DHI, on amd64 and arm64; the version banner in its libc.so.6 names that Debian release (glibc 2.41). We checked the libc6 package of that build for both architectures against the repository index checksum: the Debian changelog it ships carries the 2.41-12+deb13u3 entry that applies the upstream stable-branch fix for CVE-2026-4437. The range ends at that build.
